description: SAP Reference Solution Architecture (RSA) — exact application names as they appear in the SAP RSA catalog. Use these verbatim in the 'rsa' field.

applications.name: SAP S/4HANA
applications.use_when: Standard S/4HANA functionality with no additional licensed products required.

applications.name: SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA
applications.use_when: Requirement explicitly involves SAP Ariba for sourcing, procurement, contracts, or supplier management. Not to be used for standard MM purchasing.

applications.name: SAP Integration Suite, SAP S/4HANA
applications.use_when: Requirement involves middleware, API integration, EDI, or connectivity to external systems via SAP BTP Integration Suite.

applications.name: SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP S/4HANA
applications.use_when: Requirement involves advanced analytics, dashboards, planning, or reporting beyond S/4HANA Embedded Analytics — using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).

applications.name: SAP SuccessFactors, SAP S/4HANA
applications.use_when: Requirement involves HR processes, workforce management, or people analytics integrated with S/4HANA.

applications.name: SAP Fieldglass, SAP S/4HANA
applications.use_when: Requirement involves external workforce management, contingent labour, or services procurement via SAP Fieldglass.
